import os, json

root = "workspace/unpacked"
for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
    level = dirpath.replace(root, "").count(os.sep)
    indent = "  " * level
    print(f"{indent}{os.path.basename(dirpath)}/")
    for f in sorted(filenames):
        print(f"{indent}  {f}")

import re, sys
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    print("=" * 20, path, "=" * 20)
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        xml = f.read()
    # crude text extraction: pull contents of a:t elements
    texts = re.findall(r"<a:t>(.*?)</a:t>", xml, re.S)
    for t in texts:
        print(repr(t))

import shutil

# Backup original before any modifications
shutil.copy("Q4_financial_report.pptx", "Q4_financial_report.backup.pptx")

root = "workspace/unpacked"

# 1. [Content_Types].xml: register slide6.xml
ct_path = root + "/[Content_Types].xml"
with open(ct_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    ct = f.read()
new_override = '  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n'
assert '</Types>' in ct and '/ppt/slides/slide5.xml' in ct
ct = ct.replace('</Types>', new_override + '</Types>')
with open(ct_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ct)

# 2. ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels: add relationship rId13 -> slides/slide6.xml
rels_path = root + "/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"
with open(rels_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rels = f.read()
new_rel = '  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>\n'
assert '</Relationships>' in rels and 'rId12' in rels
rels = rels.replace('</Relationships>', new_rel + '</Relationships>')
with open(rels_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(rels)

# 3. ppt/presentation.xml: add slide id 261 -> rId13 at end of sldIdLst
pres_path = root + "/ppt/presentation.xml"
with open(pres_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    pres = f.read()
new_sldid = '    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>\n'
assert '</p:sldIdLst>' in pres and 'rId12' in pres
pres = pres.replace('</p:sldIdLst>', new_sldid + '  </p:sldIdLst>')
with open(pres_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(pres)

print("done")
